title: Confined-space entry
goal: Show controls preventing hazardous-atmosphere exposure and mitigating its consequences.

rubric.must: A named hazard and the central top event Entrant exposed to hazardous atmosphere are visible.
Multiple labelled threats through preventative barriers visibly lead from the left to the top event.
Multiple labelled consequences through mitigative barriers visibly lead from the top event to the right.
An escalation factor and its barrier are visibly attached beneath a named preventive barrier.
The picture has a clear left-threat, central-event, right-consequence bowtie geometry.
Individual barrier labels are readable and distinguish prevention from mitigation.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Both satisfy the blockers, but the SVG also shows the required escalation factor and escalation barrier attached beneath Atmospheric testing before entry, which the picture omits.
